name: Open Lovable
description: Example app from the Firecrawl team that builds React applications from a chat conversation inside a cloud sandbox.
whatItDoes: Open Lovable lets a user describe or point at a site and get a working React app generated and previewed. It is a self-hostable sample that shows how a prompt-to-app builder can be assembled. Developers run it locally with their own keys.
howItWorks: A web app sends the conversation to a chosen LLM, uses Firecrawl to pull in web content, and executes the generated project in a Vercel or E2B sandbox. An optional fast-apply service speeds up edits. All keys go into a local env file.

requirements.name: FIRECRAWL_API_KEY
requirements.description: Web scraping used by the builder

requirements.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
requirements.description: One LLM provider key is needed; Gemini is one option
